classes.description: Replace Reason — 替换原因代码定义实体。定义制造过程中物料/组件替换的原因分类（如来料不良、工艺变更、临时替代等）。 【Swagger】Schema: ReplaceReasonEntity；来源文件: ReplaceReasons.json；API: /api/ReplaceReasons。

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注信息 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联的图标 ID 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: name
properties.description: 替换原因的唯一名称（必填） 【Swagger】Unique name for this instance

properties.name: isScrapRemoved
properties.description: 若所选替换原因勾选了报废但组件无需报废，操作员可取消勾选。 【Swagger】If the selected replacement reason has scrapped checked and the component doesn't need to be scrapped the operator should be able to uncheck that box.

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified
